card.name: Start of split capitalized or technical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split up, often in capitals or in all-caps headings such as WARNINGS. Examples are PED in PEDRO, WARN in WARNINGS, throm in thrombotic, and shar in sharps.
